grants.description: Verify your identity using your GOV.UK One Login credentials
grants.purpose: To confirm you are the parent or guardian of the child and entitled to share their information

grants.description: Check your child's Free School Meals eligibility history with local authority and DfE records
grants.purpose: To determine if your child has ever qualified for Free School Meals and is therefore eligible for Pupil Premium funding

grants.description: Share your child's Pupil Premium eligibility status with their school
grants.purpose: The school will use this information to claim Pupil Premium funding from DfE and allocate resources to support your child's education

grants.description: Confirm your child's current school and year group
grants.purpose: To ensure the school receives the correct funding allocation for your child

revocation.mechanism: Contact your child's school or the local authority to withdraw consent for data sharing
revocation.effect: The school will no longer receive Pupil Premium funding for your child, which may reduce resources available to support their education

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot change your child's school details without your explicit confirmation. Agent cannot revoke consent on your behalf. Agent can only check FSM history, not apply for FSM.
